Binary uploads initially require a direct cPanel UAPI handle by client policy pending evidence; this is not an upstream bridge prohibition. Upload scalar emits file; nonempty sequential lists emit file-1, file-2 even for a singleton. No source-path inference or mixed modes. Server-path query backup remains omitted and deferred under whm-api-client-8x0.30.9.

The server declares no rollback. One request is sent without automatic retry or rollback. Optional strict string log_id and log_path remain an actual nonnullable object; empty object is valid, absent/null/list payloads mismatch. Log paths are sensitive payload data and are not fetched. Results do not establish atomicity, completion or per-file success.

Restore and verbose messages are in responseMeta()->uapi['messages'], not the returned array. On API failure the Flag policy raises ApiErrorException before data validation, so unvalidated log_id/log_path are unavailable; errors() retains the upstream error text.

The client preserves archive list order on the wire, but upstream application order is unreliable. PR89 reviewer observations on cPanel 11.138.0.19 found overlapping-archive results disagreeing with list order in three of five permutations. Overlapping archives have unpredictable results; callers needing a specific result should restore one archive per call. This adds no completion, atomicity or rollback guarantee.
